limitations: Reichman uses a bagrut-average gate (ממוצע בגרות 100 ומעלה לקבלה ישירה) plus an adapted-score formula for ranking, not a published per-program sekhem threshold.
The official calculator is a client-side ASP.NET WebForms bagrut-average helper; per-program adapted-score cutoffs are not published as a static table and remain behind the calculator.
overrides.decisionReason: Official Reichman admissions pages verify the rule: ממוצע בגרות 100 ומעלה לקבלה ישירה במסלול המבוקש, plus דרישת אנגלית. The reverse-engineered adapted-score formula is Adapted = 4.812 × BagrutAverage + 0.5131 × Psychometric − 163.19, but no per-program adapted-score cutoff is published statically, so the product bucket is eligible-to-apply rather than accepted/below.
overrides.nextAction: הגישו מועמדות דרך המרכז האישי; ודאו עמידה בממוצע בגרות 100+ וברמת האנגלית הנדרשת למסלול.

limitations: Verified: the official BGU calculator endpoints (!rg.acc_SubmitSekem and variants) return a weighted score only; admission cutoff, rejection cutoff, and explicit pass/fail fields are all N/A.
BGU columns confirm סף הקבלה משתנה לפי המחלקה והתוכנית, so per-program thresholds are not published by the calculator and must come from an alternate official source.
overrides.decisionReason: Official BGU calculator verified to compute a weighted score but returns no threshold or admission status. Without an official per-program cutoff, a yes/no decision cannot be reproduced server-side.
overrides.nextAction: Find an alternate official BGU source that publishes per-program admission thresholds/status (e.g. department pages or a ספי קבלה PDF) before promoting BGU to decision-capable.

limitations: Verified: Ariel's calculator (pniot.ariel.ac.il) is protected by Radware WAF and requires a stateful two-step browser session with valid tracking cookies; plain HTTP reproduction returns a 247 challenge.
Browser automation (Playwright/Puppeteer) is required to obtain cookies and reproduce the calculation; no alternate static official threshold page was found.
overrides.decisionReason: Official Ariel calculator verified to be Radware-protected and stateful; programmatic reproduction without a browser engine is not possible.
overrides.nextAction: Move Ariel to a browser-automation lane (Hermes/VPS) or find an alternate official Ariel admissions page that publishes thresholds statically.

limitations: Verified: Bar-Ilan's calculator (shoham.biu.ac.il) is protected by Radware Bot Manager with hCaptcha; both /registration and /registration-and-admission/information/general-admission-req return a Radware Captcha page for non-browser clients.
The calculator is an ASP.NET AJAX UpdatePanel postback requiring __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION plus valid Radware tracking cookies; CAPTCHA solving or a browser engine is mandatory.
overrides.decisionReason: Official Bar-Ilan admissions pages verified to be Radware/hCaptcha-protected; programmatic reproduction without CAPTCHA solving is not possible.
